chain_words.nuance: very strong anger, often hard to control
anger so intense it provokes an extreme reaction

explanation: These words all express anger, with intensity rising from mild annoyance to uncontrolled rage. Each step names a stronger shade of the same emotion.

usage_notes.difference: 'Annoyed' describes mild, usually brief irritation; 'angry' describes a stronger feeling that is often directed at a person or at an unfair situation.
